definition.child: a child process restores the parent snapshot under verifier:v1, expresses the 20 describe sentences, corrects the CUP description to GREEN, expresses the last sentence again, and writes a second snapshot
definition.before: the child's 20 before texts must equal '{object}在{place}'
definition.after: the child's 20 after texts must substitute GREEN for CUP and keep every place
definition.handback: the parent restores the child snapshot; digest, text and 20/20 texts match
definition.corrupt: a second child receives truncated bytes and must reject them with rejected_snapshot_invalid_json
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.child_import: child restored digest equals the parent digest
criteria.after: 20/20 after pairs and texts exact; CUP sentences become GREEN; places unchanged
criteria.handback: parent restored digest equals child snapshot digest; text and 20/20 after texts match
criteria.corrupt: child error starts with rejected_snapshot_invalid_json and no output exists
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R32 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
